risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights uncertainties related to macroeconomic conditions, including trade tensions, commercial policy uncertainty, and inflationary risks, which could negatively impact business performance.

risks.title: Transitional Dependence on Honeywell
risks.score_rationale: The company was recently spun off from Honeywell and relies on transition services through a transitional services agreement, creating risks related to operational and financial transition.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company identifies supply chain risks, including raw material shortages, price fluctuations, and volatility arising from global conflicts and trade policies.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets for advanced materials, refrigerants, and electronic materials, creating risks related to market share loss.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental and safety regulations in the manufacturing of advanced materials and refrigerants.

risks.title: Transition and Spin-off Costs
risks.score_rationale: The company incurred $117 million in transaction costs related to the spin-off in 2025, with additional costs expected through 2026 as it establishes itself as an independent public entity.
